yt_description:
Still managing client content on spreadsheets? Lost approvals. Missed posts. Endless email threads.

Stackby turns your spreadsheets into a real Client Portal: one portal per client for content, approvals and reports. Import your sheet, every row becomes a record, and your portal is live in minutes. Or just describe what you need and Stackby AI builds it.

👉 Build your client portal, free to start: https://stackby.com/signup
